authority: User in this Codex thread: Sounds good, I'm fine with it as-is as long as it works but feel free to try out anything that might be an improvement.
rationale: Tagged16 table behavior already depended on CDK outlet fields and an internal no-data root-class override within the matching Material/CDK implementation. The add-on adapts that wiring to current peers. A real Angular public-module-only outlet substitution fails because the upstream directives require private CDK_TABLE. The simple public contentChanged cleanup alternative loses the distinction between authored and injected CDK classes, so it cannot preserve both legitimate historical outcomes.
required_invariants: Preserve Material 16 rendered HTML, CSS, SCSS and authored classes without consumer changes
Authenticate actual peer implementation and requalify when it changes
Exercise real outlet ownership, initialization, destruction, native/flex and nested tables, and no-data lifecycle behavior
Do not extend this exception to unrelated private dependencies or a CDK fork
qualification_status: Current bounded cell/no-data replays passed in separately retained receipts. Complete packed Angular table and release-matrix qualification remains required.
